apps.name: FormReady
apps.shortDescription: FormReady is an offline-first document preparation application designed to help users create upload-ready documents quickly and easily.
keyFeatures: Document Scanning •  Capture documents using the device camera. •  Import existing images from the gallery.
Manual Cropping •  Precisely adjust document boundaries. •  Remove unnecessary background areas.
Document Enhancement •  Improve document readability. •  Create cleaner and more professional document appearance.
Format Conversion Convert documents into: •  JPG •  PNG •  PDF
File Size Optimization Prepare documents according to specific upload requirements.
